product_metadata.title: InstaTrak Pivoting Head Digital Instant Read Meat Food Grill BBQ Kitchen Cooking Thermometer
features: Pivoting display provides perfect viewing angles
Stable temperature readings in less than 7 seconds
Large display digits are 1/2-inches tall for easy reading
description: Feel like a pro in the kitchen - get quick digital accuracy from the InstaTrack Pivoting Display Kitchen Thermometer. The adjustable head provides the perfect viewing angle from any direction. Roasting, grilling, baking or event candy making are a breeze with the instant response time of this thermometer. InstaTrack wants to make sure that every meal is served at the proper temperatures for food safety and over course flavor! Let this thermometer be the start of the kitchen. A pocket case is included that can also be used as a handle extension by threading the stem through the metal clip at the top of the sleeve. The temperature range is -58°F to 572°F (-50°C to 300°C). A LR44 battery is included. Helpful hints: Digital thermometers are NOT meant to be left in food during cooking. The plastic and electronic components could be damaged with excessive heat.
